method: Temporary React Profiler around MatterChat; temporary performance mark at ClaimMarkdown entry. Both removed from application code after measurement.
environment: Existing localhost:3000 Next.js development server; Codex in-app browser; Harbor 2 saved conversation with 106 messages and eight open document tabs.

before.observation: Sequential typing timed out; baseline includes measured keystrokes that completed. Development StrictMode is enabled.

after.observation: All twelve characters of the test suffix appeared; each update reused the saved-content tree.

limits: Render durations are not full input-to-paint latency. Browser automation inserts its own pacing. Chrome was not separately profiled.
